title: Solenoidal maps, automatic sequences, van der Put series, and Mealy-Moore automata
notes: Extends the correspondence between finite Mealy automata and automatic van der Put coefficient sequences from prime bases to arbitrary d-adic integers and gives conversions between Mealy and Moore descriptions. Its d=3 specialization is relevant to encoding 3-adic 1-Lipschitz dynamics, but finite-state realizability remains a condition to verify rather than an automatic consequence.
